bio: Her descent, step by step from Akerly ([R4-S1]): John Tuthill (1635-1717) -> Henry Tuthill 'the Justice' (b. 1 May 1665, d. 1750, m. Bethia Horton, dau. of Capt. Jonathan Horton & Bethia Wells) -> Henry (b. 1690, d. 1775, m. 1st Hannah, d. 1715) -> Henry (b. before Dec 1715, d. 17 Sep 1793, m. 16 Mar 1738 Phoebe Horton, dau. of Caleb, son of Caleb, son of Caleb, son of Barnabas Horton) -> Anna. She is therefore 4 generations below John Tuthill (1635), John's 12th-great-grandfather: 3C8R. She descends from William Wells (John's 11th-great-grandfather) through Bethia Wells -> Bethia Horton: 3C8R by that route too, and twice from Barnabas Horton (see openQuestionsNew).
sources: [R4-S1] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 8-10 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker
[R4-S2] Wikipedia, 'John Cleves Symmes' (intro via MediaWiki API) (secondary) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Cleves_Symmes

openQuestions: Barnabas Horton route: Anna's mother Phoebe Horton (Caleb-Caleb-Caleb-Barnabas) and grandmother Bethia Horton (Jonathan-Barnabas) both descend from Barnabas Horton, whom Round 3 places 13 generations above John via Rachel Browne (probable, compiled). If that holds, Anna is also a 4C9R twice over through Barnabas Horton.
